``` {r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

The data being manipulated in this post is from the Palmer Penguins dataset, loaded in from base R.

``` {r}
penguins_numerical <- penguins |> select(bill_length_mm:body_mass_g) |>  drop_na() |> round()

head(penguins_numerical)
```
Table 1: Palmer Penguins Data Numerical Stats
``` {r}
penguins_grouping <- penguins |> group_by(species, island) |> nest()

head(penguins_grouping)
```
Table 2: Palmer Penguins Grouped by Species and Island
``` {r}
penguins_mass <- penguins |> mutate(body_mass_lb = body_mass_g/453.592) |> select(species, island, body_mass_lb) |> drop_na()

head(penguins_mass)
```
Table 3: Palmer Penguins Mass Grouped By Species and Island
